# sherpa-section-header

A semantic heading row for a content section.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Category | container |
| Figma | Section Header |
| Source | [.ts](../../src/components/sherpa-section-header/sherpa-section-header.ts) · [.html](../../src/components/sherpa-section-header/sherpa-section-header.html) · [.css](../../src/components/sherpa-section-header/sherpa-section-header.css) · [.component.json](../../src/components/sherpa-section-header/sherpa-section-header.component.json) · [.example.json](../../src/components/sherpa-section-header/sherpa-section-header.example.json) |

## Example

```html
<sherpa-section-header data-heading="Details"><span slot="description">How you appear to your team.</span></sherpa-section-header>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-divider` | `none` |  | bottom divider; shown by DEFAULT — set data-divider="none" to hide it |
| `data-heading` | text |  | heading text (rendered into .title) |
| `data-size` | `sm` `md` `lg` | `md` | sm \| md \| lg |

## Slots

| Slot | Accepts | What it holds |
|---|---|---|
| `heading` | text | custom heading element (replaces the default .title) |
| `description` | text | description text below the heading (reflects has-description) |
| `actions` | control | trailing action controls (reflects has-actions) |

## Parts

Style these from outside with `::part()`:

`actions`, `description`, `divider`, `lead`, `row`, `title`

`{ divider?, heading?, size? }`

Its declared props by name: `label` sets data-label.
